description: The data-table wrapper uses overflow-x:auto, so any table wider than the viewport scrolls sideways instead of collapsing to a stacked list — violates the no-horizontal-scroll and table-collapse rules at narrow widths.

section: ADMIN DATA TABLE — table.admin-table thead th
description: Header cells force white-space:nowrap, which (together with the wrapper's overflow-x) keeps the table from shrinking and contributes to sideways scroll at narrow widths.
suggestedFix:
Allow header text to wrap on narrow screens (header is hidden entirely in the collapse pattern, but for the tablet range add):
@media (max-width: 700px) { table.admin-table thead th { white-space: normal; word-break: break-word; padding: 8px 12px; } }

description: The tab strip uses overflow-x:auto with .admin-tabs { min-width: max-content }, producing horizontal scrolling of the whole nav at 250px. Per rubric this is a defect even for navigation; tabs should wrap.
min-width: max-content forces the tab row to be as wide as all tabs combined, guaranteeing horizontal overflow at narrow widths instead of wrapping.
suggestedFix: Add a narrow-width override: @media (max-width: 700px) { .admin-tabs { min-width: 0; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 0 10px; } }

description: min-width:200px on the search wrapper plus the toolbar's 10px gap and the content's 24px side padding exceeds a 250px viewport, forcing horizontal overflow.
suggestedFix: @media (max-width: 480px) { .admin-search-wrap { min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; flex: 1 1 100%; } }

description: min-width:130px on the select; with toolbar gaps and content padding this can push the toolbar past a 250px viewport. Selects should be allowed to go full width when wrapped onto their own line.
Fixed padding:24px on all sides with no responsive reduction; 48px of horizontal padding is a large fraction of a 250px viewport and squeezes inner content.
Fixed horizontal padding:0 24px (48px total) and gap:16px with no narrow-width reduction; with the brand block plus action buttons this overflows at 250px.
suggestedFix: @media (max-width: 480px) { .admin-topbar { padding: 0 12px; gap: 8px; } }

description: Pagination is a flex row with justify-content:space-between and no flex-wrap plus fixed padding:14px 20px; the info text and the controls cluster cannot shrink and overflow horizontally at narrow widths.
Card header is a space-between flex row with no flex-wrap; a long title plus right-side action will not wrap and can overflow horizontally at narrow widths.
suggestedFix:
.admin-card-header { flex-wrap: wrap; }
@media (max-width: 480px) { .admin-card-header { padding: 12px 14px; } }

description: Sub-tabs are a flex row (align-items:stretch) with no flex-wrap; multiple sub-tab buttons will overflow horizontally at narrow widths instead of wrapping.
suggestedFix: @media (max-width: 700px) { .case-sub-tabs-wrap { flex-wrap: wrap; } }

description: Tab buttons set white-space:nowrap and flex-shrink:0 with fixed padding 0 18px; combined with the max-content row these prevent wrapping and contribute to nav overflow at narrow widths. (nowrap on a short tab label is borderline acceptable, but flex-shrink:0 + nowrap together block any reflow.)
suggestedFix: @media (max-width: 700px) { .admin-tab-btn { padding: 0 12px; height: 42px; } }

description: Fixed 110px label width/min-width inside a flex meta-row; combined with 20px horizontal padding it consumes ~150px, leaving almost nothing for .case-meta-value at a 250px viewport even after the meta grid collapses to one column.
Fixed 20px horizontal padding on each meta row has no narrow-width reduction; on a 250px viewport it eats 40px of width on top of the 110px fixed label.
Devotee name is truncated with nowrap + overflow:hidden + ellipsis instead of wrapping; the rubric explicitly forbids ellipsis/nowrap on real content like names.
currentCode: .appt-name  { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--admin-text-primary); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
suggestedFix: .appt-name  { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--admin-text-primary); overflow-wrap: anywhere; word-break: break-word; }

description: Fixed min-width:58px time column plus 20px row padding and 14px gap inside .appt-list-item leaves little room for .appt-info at 250px; the row never wraps (flex with no flex-wrap), so the name column is heavily squeezed.
Fixed 20px horizontal padding and 14px gap with no narrow-width reduction on a row holding a time column, dot, and name; reduces usable name width at 250px.
max-width:360px combined with fixed right:24px / bottom:24px positioning causes the toast to overflow the viewport horizontally at widths below ~384px (down to 250px), producing horizontal scroll.

max-width:280px exceeds a 250px viewport; with the parent .admin-empty 24px side padding the block is already constrained, but the 280px cap itself is wider than 250px. Low risk since parent padding constrains it, flagged for completeness.
currentCode: .admin-empty .empty-desc  { font-size: 13px; color: var(--admin-text-dim); max-width: 280px; line-height: 1.6; }
suggestedFix:
.admin-empty .empty-desc  { font-size: 13px; color: var(--admin-text-dim); max-width: 100%; line-height: 1.6; }
(or max-width: min(280px, 100%))

description: Fixed 56px vertical / 24px horizontal padding with no narrow-width reduction; 48px combined horizontal padding is a meaningful fraction of a 250px viewport.
Fixed 24px padding all around with no narrow-width reduction; on a 250px viewport this consumes 48px of width with no responsive scale-down.
Fixed 22px horizontal padding with no narrow-width reduction inside the slide panel which becomes full-width on mobile; 44px combined horizontal padding is large at 250px.
Fixed 22px padding all around with no narrow-width reduction; full-width drawer on mobile loses 44px of horizontal space.
suggestedFix: Covered by the @media (max-width:480px) block adding .admin-panel-body { padding: 16px 14px; } (see admin-panel-header fix).

description: Has a 640px media query reducing padding to 28px 22px, but at 250px the 22px each side (44px total) is still sizeable with no further step-down; borderline, flagged for completeness.
currentCode: @media (max-width: 640px) { .form-card-elegant { padding: 28px 22px; border-radius: 18px; } }
suggestedFix:
Add a finer step:
@media (max-width: 380px) { .form-card-elegant { padding: 20px 14px; border-radius: 14px; } }

description: Fixed height:50px is fine for width (width:100% + box-sizing present) but does not scale; not a horizontal-overflow issue. Width handling is correct. Flagged only as a minor non-scaling fixed dimension.
Fixed 28px vertical / 30px horizontal padding with no narrow-width reduction; 60px combined horizontal padding is excessive at a 250px viewport.

Flex row with space-between holding .adm-hero-left (icon + title text) and .adm-hero-right (live badge + buttons) has no flex-wrap; at 250px the two wide groups cannot fit side by side and will force overflow. The @640px query hides some labels but does not allow the row to wrap.

The live badge plus out/gold buttons in .adm-hero-right take significant fixed width; while the @640px query hides button text, the live badge remains and competes for space at 250px. Consider hiding the live badge at very narrow widths.

The smallest breakpoint defined is 480px. Below ~250px no further reductions exist for many fixed paddings/widths in this chunk (case-panel-meta still single-col but padded, hero row, toasts). The chunk never targets very narrow (≤320px/250px) viewports, so several fixed-px elements above remain unhandled at 250px.
Fixed 16px/20px padding plus a 36px icon and 14px gap in a flex row with no flex-wrap; on a 250px viewport the icon + padding + gap leave a narrow text column. No narrow-width reduction.
